findings.title: Wave-like interpenetration becomes ordered assembly
findings.claim: After the barrier's release, the focus's wave-like crowd motion is not the endpoint: the trumpet event changes that interpenetrating field into an ordered gathering of scattered parts.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries wave motion in يَمُوجُ, trumpet blowing in نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ, and gathering action plus cognate noun in فَجَمَعْنَاهُمْ جَمْعًا. The wider records return wave imagery at 11:42 and trumpet-to-gathering sequences at 69:13 and 20:102, while 18:98 supplies the release that makes the transition legible.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive a phase change inside the ayah: mutual interpenetration is a temporary mode, and the same field is subsequently brought into a complete assembly.
findings.containment: This retains the plain human crowd and trumpet-gathering sequence. It does not literalize the crowd as water, make the wider ayat one identical scene, or claim a political or human mechanism for the final assembly.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication supplies exact focus anchors for the retained relation; the two legacy_unbound reader walks corroborate the same transition, while connection targets provide exact Arabic but not target morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey düzenli duruşunu yitirerek dalga gibi çalkalanır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus form يَمُوجُ carries ongoing wave-like churning into the human field introduced by the two partitive forms.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 18:98 supplies the barrier's promised release, and 11:42 supplies a wider wave image involving people and water movement.
branch_activations.activation: The released-field context and the wider wave image meet the focus's wave carrier, making the crowd's interpenetration a materially visible phase rather than a static gathering.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The people are shown in a wave-like state of motion and mutual interpenetration before the later assembly.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not turn the people into literal water or claim that 11:42 and 18:99 narrate the same event.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsan topluluğunda çalkalanma, kalabalığın birbirinin içine girip karışması biçiminde gerçekleşir.
branch_activations.carrier: The human crowd is the focus's actual field of the wave verb, so the motion is carried as people entering into one another rather than as an isolated water image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The barrier-release connection and the wave parallel independently supply release and crowd-wave contact.
branch_activations.activation: The human-object field in the focus gives the wave branch its associated crowd realization, while the wider wave connection returns that realization beyond the focus.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The disorder is mutual interpenetration among groups, not merely movement from one place to another.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not claim a numerical group structure or suppress the ordinary eschatological scene.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hava ya da soluk, bir şeyin içine veya üzerine gider ya da gönderilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The passive نُفِخَ carries the ordinary event of air or breath being sent into the following instrument.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 69:13 supplies the exact wider phrase نفخ في الصور and identifies the blast as a single trumpet event.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's passive blowing meets the wider trumpet formula, so the connective turn is an efficacious event rather than an unspecified sound.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The blast functions as the event that interrupts the wave-like state and opens the gathering.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not decide who performs the blowing or add a separate breath-of-life scene.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dinsel anlatımda kıyamet borusuna üfleme ve soluk üfleyerek can verme kullanımları bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The passive blowing form occurs directly beside the focus's trumpet noun, carrying the supplied eschatological blowing use.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider 69:13 wording repeats the trumpet-blast construction and supplies the eschatological contact.
branch_activations.activation: The exact trumpet construction turns the general air-blowing branch into its religious trumpet specialization while retaining the core blowing action.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The clause boundary is marked by the eschatological trumpet blast that leads into assembly.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not import the branch's separate life-giving-breath use.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Nesne, içine üflenerek kullanılan boynuz biçimli bir araçtır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun ٱلصُّورِ names the object receiving the blast in the supplied trumpet formula.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 69:13 supplies the exact phrase in which the trumpet object receives a single blast.
branch_activations.activation: The wider exact phrase returns through the focus noun and activates the horn-as-instrument branch alongside the focus's blowing verb.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The trumpet clause has a concrete instrument as its event boundary, not an unspecified form or image.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains the qualified horn reading without activating the alternative forms-related branches under the same root.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ayrı parçalar birbirine yaklaştırılır ve dağınıklık sona erdirilir.
branch_activations.carrier: فَجَمَعْنَاهُمْ جَمْعًا carries the action of bringing the scattered field together, reinforced by the cognate noun.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 20:102 pairs the trumpet blast with a gathering outcome, returning the focus's blast-to-assembly sequence from a wider scene.
branch_activations.activation: The wider trumpet-and-gathering sequence meets the focus's gathered object and cognate accusative, making the second clause the organized result of the first clause's turbulence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The wave-like crowd is brought from mutual mixture into a single comprehensive act of gathering.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not reduce gathering to physical transport or claim that the wider scene supplies all details of the focus's account.

findings.title: The endpoint is a complete human assembly
findings.claim: Wider gathering parallels make the endpoint legible as a complete human assembly: the people themselves are brought together, with no implied remainder.
findings.mechanism: The plural object in جَمَعْنَاهُمْ and the cognate accusative جَمْعًا provide the focus carriers. The wider Arabic in 3:9 gathers people and 4:87 gathers all people, returning the human-group and all-members-present relations through the focus gathering.
findings.reader_payoff: The final جمع is perceived as populated and exhaustive: the assembly concerns people as a whole, not an abstract set of items with an unspecified remainder.
findings.containment: This adds human scope and completeness to the ordinary gathering action; it does not replace the process reading, import every detail of 3:9 or 4:87, or activate unrelated branches of the gathering root.

epistemic.reason: The focus carriers and trusted publication are exact, while the wider connection rows supply target Arabic and relation notes without target morphology. The completeness branch is therefore retained with its qualification visible.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Birden çok insan bir arada bulunan bir topluluk oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The plural object and cognate noun in جَمَعْنَاهُمْ جَمْعًا can carry a gathered human multitude while the ordinary gathering action remains.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 3:9 explicitly names God as gathering people, providing a wider human-assembly return.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's human plural object meets the wider people-gathering image, so the endpoint reads as a gathered human group rather than an abstract set of items.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The assembly is populated by people as a collective.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not replace the bringing-together action or import every detail of 3:9 into 18:99.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Canlının bedeninden hiçbir parça eksilmemiştir ve varlık bütündür.
branch_activations.carrier: The gathering expression can carry the condition of an undiminished whole alongside its ordinary action sense.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 4:87 explicitly says that God gathers all people, supplying a wider all-members trigger.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's intensified gathering meets the wider all-people formulation, making completeness a changed condition of the assembly rather than a numerical guess.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The gathered field is complete as a whole, with no missing portion asserted by the wider return.
branch_activations.boundary: The qualified completeness branch is not being generalized to every use of the root or treated as the only meaning of جَمْعًا.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir topluluğun üyeleri eksiksiz biçimde hep birlikte bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The cognate-accusative جمعًا seals the gathering as the whole membership being present, not merely as an act that begins but may remain incomplete.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider all-people gathering in 4:87 independently supplies the no-omission contact.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's intensified gathering and the wider total-gathering image meet at the condition of every member being present.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The terminal assembly is exhaustive in membership while remaining the result of the gathering action.
branch_activations.boundary: This extension does not claim that the focus separately states every judicial consequence of the wider ayah.
